<style id="smartSf9WordStylePanel">

.word-tools-head{background:#17191d;color:#fff;padding:12px 13px 10px}.word-tools-title{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.word-tools-title b{font:900 14px Arial,sans-serif}.word-tools-title button{width:auto!important;min-height:30px!important;padding:5px 8px!important;margin:0!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)!important;text-align:center!important;font-size:9px!important}.word-tools-current{margin-top:9px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:5px}.word-tools-current label{font:800 8px Arial,sans-serif;color:#ff9fc5;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.5px}.word-tools-current select{width:100%;min-height:35px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;font:800 10px Arial,sans-serif}
.word-tools-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd4d8;padding:7px;gap:5px}.word-tools-tabs button{min-height:34px!important;width:100%!important;margin:0!important;background:#fff!important;color:#4b4146!important;border:1px solid #e7dce1!important;text-align:center!important;padding:6px!important;font:900 9px Arial,sans-serif!important}.word-tools-tabs button.active{background:#ef4b8b!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#ef4b8b!important}
.word-tools-body{height:calc(100vh - 154px);overflow:auto;padding:10px;background:#f7f6f7}.word-tool-panel{display:none}.word-tool-panel.active{display:block}.word-tool-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e4d9de;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:9px}.word-tool-card h4{font:900 10px Arial,sans-serif;margin:0 0 3px;color:#2e272b;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}.word-tool-card p{font:600 9px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif;color:#7b6b73;margin:0 0 8px}
.word-tool-card .control-label{display:block!important;color:#b52f65!important;font:900 8px Arial,sans-serif!important;margin:7px 1px 4px!important}.word-tool-card select,.word-tool-card button{width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;min-height:35px!important;border-radius:8px!important;margin:0 0 6px!important;font:800 10px Arial,sans-serif!important;text-align:left!important}.word-tool-card select{border:1px solid #ddcfd5!important;background:#fff!important;color:#222!important;padding:7px!important}.word-tool-card button{border:1px solid #e2d6db!important;background:#fff!important;color:#332a2e!important;padding:7px 9px!important}.word-tool-card button:hover{border-color:#ef4b8b!important;background:#fff4f8!important}.word-tool-card .print-btn,.word-tool-card .batch-print-btn{background:#ef4b8b!important;color:#fff!important;text-align:center!important;border-color:#ef4b8b!important}.word-tool-card .zoom-controls{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr 38px 50px!important;gap:4px!important}.word-tool-card .zoom-controls button{margin:0!important;text-align:center!important;padding:4px!important}.word-tool-card .zoom-value{display:grid!important;place-items:center;background:#f6f1f3;border:1px solid #e5dade;border-radius:8px;font:900 10px Arial,sans-serif;color:#32292d}

body.sf9-word-tools .toolbar>button.back-dash,body.sf9-word-tools .toolbar>button:not([id]):not(.print-btn):not(.batch-print-btn),body.sf9-word-tools .toolbar>.titlebar,body.sf9-word-tools .toolbar>.mode-badge{display:none}
@media(max-width:950px){body.sf9-word-tools .toolbar{width:270px!important}body.sf9-word-tools #app{margin-right:270px!important}body.sf9-word-tools .hint{right:270px!important;margin-right:270px!important}}
